decisions.working_title: Internet use grew at different speeds across countries and areas, 2000–2024
decisions.question: How much did the share using the Internet change among places with observations in both 2000 and 2024?
decisions.thesis: The 175 comparable UN M49 country-or-area entities show a wide distribution of percentage-point changes; the middle change was 67.9 points in the reviewed snapshot.
required_labels: Fixed 2000/2024 paired cohort of 175 UN M49 country-or-area entities; each entity has equal weight in the distribution.
Changes are percentage points, not relative percentage growth.
Indicator is Internet use in the previous three months, not connection quality or affordability.
blocked_claims: 2024 levels form a quantified distribution or ranking: no such distribution metric was approved in Step 8.
The 175 entities are all sovereign countries or represent the entire world.
Regional aggregates, OWID_KOS, or sparse 2025 observations belong in the paired cohort.
A cause of the differing changes is established by these observations.
draft_requirements: Use the corrected title, question, and thesis rather than the original latest-year distribution premise.
Tie every numeric example to its source fact IDs and identify the 175-entity cohort next to distribution statistics.
Credit ITU via World Bank and Our World in Data.

decisions.working_title: Why the EU's renewable energy shares differ by use
decisions.question: What do the EU27's 2024 overall, electricity, transport, and heating/cooling renewable shares each measure?
decisions.thesis: The EU27's four reported renewable shares describe different energy uses and denominators; each can be compared with its own 2021 value, but the four shares cannot be added or averaged.
required_labels: EU27_2020 aggregate only, annual shares, 2024 common year.
Each 2021–2024 change is within the same nrg_bal category and expressed in percentage points.
Eurostat's RED I/RED II change creates a break between 2020 and 2021.
blocked_claims: These facts compare EU member countries or rank them.
The four shares have one denominator, can be summed, or establish one overall sector gap.
Provisional, incomplete 2025 values support the same four-category comparison.
draft_requirements: Replace the original country-comparison format and title with the revised EU27 category explanation.
Label any Cite Supply presentation as a modification of Eurostat data and include Eurostat's required non-responsibility disclaimer.
Cite the dataset code, access date, source link, and methodology break.

decisions.working_title: What the EU's annual HICP inflation rate measures
decisions.question: How should publishers read the EU27 annual-average HICP rate through 2025?
decisions.thesis: The annual-average rate describes a change in a harmonised consumer-price index; the positive 2025 rate of 2.5% means the rate was 0.1 percentage points below 2024, not that prices fell.
required_labels: EU27_2020, annual frequency, unit RCH_A_AVG, COICOP 2018 TOTAL, 2018–2025 snapshot.
The 2024–2025 comparison is a change in the annual-average rate, not the index level.
HICP covers household final monetary consumption expenditure across the territory, not any single household's experience.
blocked_claims: The data supports country or euro-area comparisons.
A slower positive inflation rate is a fall in the price level.
Adding the annual rates yields cumulative inflation.
The 2018–2025 series can be silently joined to 2026 data under the revised classification.
draft_requirements: Use the revised EU27 question rather than the original cross-country premise.
Keep annual-average rates distinct from monthly and year-on-year monthly measures.
Label modifications to Eurostat data and include its non-responsibility disclaimer.

decisions.working_title: How burned area changed across four land-cover types in the World series
decisions.question: How do the source's World burned-area estimates for 2002–2006 compare with 2021–2025 within four land-cover types?
decisions.thesis: In each selected land-cover series, the 2021–2025 mean annual burned area is lower than the 2002–2006 mean in the reviewed source snapshot.
required_labels: Source-provided World entity OWID_WRL; two five-year arithmetic means, not a two-year comparison.
Forest, savannas, shrublands/grasslands, and croplands remain separate categories.
Historical satellite detection can miss burned area and fires.
blocked_claims: The four categories sum to total global burned area.
The figures count fires or measure severity, emissions, damages, or personal risk.
The source establishes why burned area changed or that every fire was detected.
World-only results support any country or regional comparison.
draft_requirements: Show both five-year windows beside each comparison and prefer category-specific presentation.
Credit Global Wildfire Information System and Our World in Data; label transformations and limitations.
Do not imply this result is a universal decline in wildfire harm.

decisions.working_title: How to embed a reviewed calculator
decisions.question: What should a publisher verify before embedding a creator-hosted calculator?
decisions.thesis: A calculator needs separate checks for embedding, attribution, functionality, and factual data rights.
blocked_claims: A prepared checklist means a creator calculator was tested and verified.
draft_requirements: Complete and record the live rights, route, embed-function, attribution, keyboard, and mobile checks before drafting.

global_draft_conditions: Drafts remain private, non-indexable, and absent from every sitemap.
Use only approved metric IDs or source fact IDs from the matched reviewed pack; never calculate new displayed numbers in prose.
Keep the revised thesis and method visible; every number, source date, and source citation must trace to a fact or source record.
Draft approval is not publication approval. Recheck exact asset availability, source freshness, and current asset-level reuse rights before any public launch.
